result:
File written successfully at `src/lib/auth/session-handler.ts` (a formatter hook ran afterward; no further edits needed from me).

Implementation summary: exported `SessionRecord` (Zod-inferred, strict schema with 43-char base64url `sessionId`/`csrfToken`, int `expiresAt`, strict `profile{id:uuid, role:owner|helper|support, active:true}`), `SessionAuthority` interface (`limit`, `login`, `read`, `refresh`, `logout` all signal-aware, no fallback), and `handleSessionRequest`. Routes GET `/api/v1/session` (read-only, `assertSameOriginRead`) and POST `/login|/refresh|/logout` (`assertSameOriginMutation`), each with rate-limit check before body/provider work, a single shared 5s `AbortController`/`Promise.race` deadline per request (`clearTimeout` in `finally`, abort only on timeout → `dependency_unavailable` 503), exact single-cookie `__Host-hc-session` parsing (no decode, 8192-char cap, duplicate/malformed → invalid → 401+clear), strict Zod body validation (login bounded email/password via `readBoundedJson` max 4096; refresh/logout only accept empty `{}` via `readBoundedJson`), CSRF check via `assertSessionCsrf` against the server-read record's token (never client-supplied), success payload limited to `{profile:{id,role}, csrfToken, expiresAt}`, `no-store`/`nosniff`/`no-referrer` headers with no CORS, stable `{code, correlationId}` error bodies, correct `Allow` on 405, 404 for unknown paths, and catch-all 503 except for `SessionRequestError`/internal `HandlerError`. No JWT, no in-memory/default auth, no network or process.env use.

Limits: used 1 tool turn beyond the two reads (Write only); well under the 6-turn/180s budget. No permission issues encountered.
